seoTitle: How to Cancel a Domain and Get a Refund on GoDaddy
metaDescription: Learn how to cancel a GoDaddy domain properly, check refund eligibility, and request a refund from billing support before renewal charges hit.
intro: If you bought a domain on GoDaddy by mistake or no longer need it, canceling it correctly and understanding the refund policy can save you from unwanted renewal charges. This guide walks through canceling the domain, checking eligibility for a refund, and requesting one through billing support.

steps.heading: Locate the domain in your account
steps.body: Log into your GoDaddy account and find the domain you want to cancel under your domain management dashboard.

steps.heading: Cancel the domain
steps.body: Use GoDaddy's cancellation option for the domain to stop it from being active or renewing further.

steps.heading: Check GoDaddy's refund policy
steps.body: Review GoDaddy's standard refund terms, since eligibility typically depends on how soon after purchase you're requesting the refund.

steps.heading: Stop auto-renewal charges
steps.body: Disable auto-renewal on the domain separately from cancellation to make sure you're not charged again before the cancellation fully processes.

steps.heading: Request a refund from billing support
steps.body: If you're within the eligible window, contact GoDaddy's billing support directly to formally request your refund.

faq.question: Is every domain purchase on GoDaddy refundable?
faq.answer: Not always — refund eligibility generally depends on how recently the domain was purchased and GoDaddy's standard refund terms, so check the policy before assuming a refund applies.

faq.question: How do I stop GoDaddy from renewing a domain I don't want?
faq.answer: Turn off auto-renewal for that specific domain in your account settings in addition to canceling it, so you aren't charged unexpectedly.

faq.question: Who do I contact for a GoDaddy refund?
faq.answer: GoDaddy's billing support team handles refund requests, and you'll typically need to reach out directly through their support channels.

faq.question: How long does a GoDaddy refund take to process?
faq.answer: Processing times can vary, so it's best to confirm the expected timeline directly with GoDaddy billing support when you submit your request.
